blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of brain imaging provide predefined or deep-learning-derived imaging phenotypes, yet these phenotypes come from either volumetric scans or cortical surface meshes, so each captures only part of the heritable variation in brain anatomy. Here we introduce MEVA (Mesh-Enhanced Volumetric Autoencoder), a self-supervised framework that encodes voxel-level image intensity together with cortical mesh geometry, including curvature and cortical thickness at each surface vertex, into one shared set of imaging features. Combining the mesh and volumetric inputs in MEVA yields modest performance gains in age and sex prediction over models that use either input alone. When these features serve as phenotypes for GWAS in the UK Biobank, they reveal more genome-wide significant loci than features learned from volumes alone or from meshes alone. These results suggest that adding cortical surface geometry to volumetric self-supervised learning captures additional heritable variation and so increases the number of loci detected.
blocks.zh: 大脑成像的现有全基因组关联研究(GWAS)提供了预先定义或深层学习的成像苯基,然而这些苯基要么来自体积扫描,要么来自皮质地表膜,因此每个都只捕捉到大脑解剖学中可遗传变异的一部分. 在这里,我们将MEVA(Mesh-Enhanced Volumetric Autoencoder),一个自行监督的框架,将voxel-level图像强度与皮质网格几何编码,包括每个地表顶点的曲率和皮质厚度,合并成一组共享的成像特征. 将MEVA中的网格和体积投入结合起来,在年龄和性别预测方面,比仅使用两种投入的模型能略有提高。 当这些特征作为英国生物库中GWAS的苯基时,它们比单从卷或从网状体中吸取的特征揭示出更多全基因组范围的重要地物. 这些结果表明,将皮质地表几何添加到体积自控学习中可以捕捉到更多的可遗传变异,从而会增加检测到的loci.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Self-supervised learning has become a central tool for extracting structured representations from unlabeled data in domains ranging from natural language to biomedical imaging. In neuroimaging, autoencoders and contrastive learning frameworks trained on brain MRI learn compact representations that capture structural variation across a population without predefined anatomical atlases or expert-curated features 1 ; 2 . These learned representations, sometimes termed imaging endophenotypes , are appealing targets for genetic association studies, as they are high-dimensional representations learned directly from the images and may therefore be sensitive to biological variation beyond what hand-crafted imaging-derived phenotypes (IDPs) encode 1 ; 3 .
blocks.zh: 自我监督的学习已成为从自然语言到生物医学成像等各个领域的无标签数据中提取结构化表述的核心工具. 在神经成像中,接受过脑磁共振培训的自动编码器和对比性学习框架学习了紧凑的表示法,在没有预先定义的解剖图集或专家精准特征的情况下,捕捉整个人群的结构变化。 这些学习到的表达方式有时被称为成像内分泌型(成像内分泌型),是遗传关联研究的诱人目标,因为它们是直接从图像中吸取的高维表达方式,因此可能对生物变化敏感,超出了手工制作的成像外分泌型编码1;3。

blocks.en: Recent advances in machine learning offer flexible methods that learn salient features directly from raw imaging data such as T1-weighted brain MRI, capturing fine-grained structural detail and producing data-driven representations of the underlying anatomy 4 . A growing body of work has applied deep learning to derive image features for genetic discovery, spanning supervised approaches that rely on disease labels or genetic signals 5 ; 6 ; 7 ; 8 ; 9 ; 10 ; 11 and unsupervised or self-supervised methods that learn representations without annotation. In the supervised setting, Yu et al. 12 used single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) genotypes as class labels to train convolutional neural networks (CNNs) on 2D brain MRI slices, which amounts to a non-linear genome-wide association study (GWAS) but sacrifices interpretability and requires a separate classifier for each of more than 300,000 SNPs. In the unsupervised setting, Patel et al. 1 introduced Unsupervised Deep learning derived Imaging Phenotypes (UDIPs), compact 128-dimensional representations learned by 3D convolutional autoencoders directly from raw brain MRI, and GWAS of UDIPs showed higher heritability than most conventional IDPs and uncovered loci absent from earlier IDP-based GWAS. Subsequent work replaced the convolutional encoder with a vision transformer, which captures both local and long-range structure in the image and revealed further genetic associations 13 . Rakowski et al. 3 took a transfer-learning approach, applying models pretrained on brain MRI from the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) or on natural images (ImageNet) to UK Biobank T1-weighted scans to derive low-dimensional representations for GWAS. All of these volumetric approaches, however, operate on 3D intensity arrays alone and leave the folded geometry of the cortical surface unmodeled.
blocks.zh: 最近在机器学习方面的进展提供了灵活的方法,直接从原始成像数据(如T1加权脑磁共振)中学习出显著特征,捕捉出细纹结构细节并产生由数据驱动的对基础解剖学4的表示. 越来越多的工作应用了深层的学习来得出基因发现的图像特征,跨越了依赖疾病标签或基因信号的受监督方法 5 ; 6; 7; 8; 9; 10; 11 和无监督或自我监督的方法来学习不作注释的表达. 在被监管的设定中,于等12人将单核苷酸多态性(SNP)基因型作为类标签,用于在2D脑磁共振切片上进行进化神经网络(CNNs)的训练,相当于非线性基因组全结合研究(GWAS),但牺牲可解释性,需要为30多万个SNP中的每一个单独分类. 在不受监督的环境下,Patel等人介绍了无监督的深层学习衍生成像型(UDIPs),3D分解自编码器直接从生脑核磁共振中吸取的紧凑的128维表达,以及UDIPs的GWAS显示出比大多数传统境内流离失所者更高的遗传性,并发现了先前基于境内流离失所者的GWAS中缺失的地方。 随后的作品用视觉变形器来取而代之的是革命编码器,它捕捉了影像中的局部和远距离结构,并揭示出进一步的遗传关联. 13 (英语). 拉科斯基等编. 3 采用了转移学习方法,将阿尔茨海默氏病神经成像倡议(ADNI)或自然图像(ImageNet)的大脑核磁共振预先培训的模型应用到联合王国生物银行T1加权扫描中,以得出GWAS的低维表示。 然而,所有这些量子方法都单独在3D强度阵列上运行,使皮质地表的折叠几何没有被建模.

blocks.en: Compared with the growing volumetric literature, the use of mesh- and shape-based deep learning for genetic discovery remains sparse. Bonazzola et al. 14 applied unsupervised ensemble-based phenotyping to 3D surface meshes of the left ventricle and showed that learned mesh phenotypes yield genetic loci beyond those discoverable from handcrafted cardiac traits such as volume and mass. In the brain, Dufournet et al. 2 trained a self-supervised contrastive model on sulcal representations of cortical folding and identified genetic influences on folding patterns of the anterior cingulate cortex. In a complementary direction, a line of work has treated geometric shape descriptors themselves as multivariate genetic phenotypes. Ge et al. 15 extended heritability estimation to multidimensional traits and showed that shape descriptors of subcortical structures are significantly heritable above and beyond volume. Building on this idea, Primus et al. 16 used the Laplace–Beltrami spectrum to encode the geometry of 22 subcortical brain structures and the cerebellum and performed multivariate GWAS, identifying 80 unique variants influencing brain shape after controlling for volume and surface area. At the cortical surface, Naqvi et al. 17 performed a multivariate GWAS of hierarchically segmented cortical surface morphology in 19,644 individuals, identifying 472 loci influencing brain shape, 76 of which were also associated with face shape. Shadrin et al. 18 applied the multivariate omnibus statistical test (MOSTest) to vertex-wise cortical surface area and thickness in 35,657 UK Biobank participants and identified 780 unique loci, more than an eightfold increase over univariate region-of-interest GWAS. Beyond the brain itself, Goovaerts et al. 19 conducted a multivariate GWAS of 3D cranial vault shape and identified 30 loci, several of them shared with face and brain shape. Despite these efforts, to our knowledge no prior work has used a self-supervised framework to derive mesh-based brain representations for genetic discovery.

blocks.en: A recurring finding across organs and imaging modalities is that genetic associations from volumetric and surface-derived phenotypes overlap only in part and otherwise diverge substantially. In the heart, Bonazzola et al. 14 found that of 49 study-wide significant loci identified by their deep mesh framework, only 9 had been reported in prior GWAS of left-ventricular phenotypes, and 20 were attributable exclusively to the mesh-based representation. Burns et al. 20 similarly reported 43 loci from principal components of bi-ventricular surface meshes, 14 of which had not previously been associated with cardiac traits. In the brain, Primus et al. 16 showed that, after controlling for volume and surface area, 49 of 80 shape-associated variants had previously been linked to brain shape-related traits, whereas the remaining 31 were novel, confirming shape-specific signal beyond gross volumetric measures. Van der Meer et al. 21 found substantial genetic overlap between sulcal depth and other cortical traits such as thickness and surface area, yet sulcal depth still showed a higher locus yield and higher heritability. Naqvi et al. 17 reported that a multivariate GWAS of cortical surface shape recaptured part of the signal from prior surface-area and subcortical-volume GWAS (121 of 472 loci), whereas most loci (351) were newly described. The consistent pattern across these studies is that volumetric measures capture coarse size variation, whereas mesh and shape representations encode geometry that is at least partly genetically independent. Most comparisons to date, however, rest on catalog-based overlap counts after covariate adjustment and stop short of formal colocalization or fine-mapping, so the mechanistic relationship between the two signal sources remains incompletely resolved. This partial complementarity motivates a framework that captures both sources of heritable variation at once.

blocks.en: We address this gap with the Mesh-Enhanced Volumetric Autoencoder (MEVA), a dual-stream architecture that uses volumetric MRI and cortical surface representations together. The volumetric stream encodes the T1-weighted MRI volume, whereas the mesh stream separately encodes vertex-wise cortical features derived from FreeSurfer-reconstructed surfaces 22 . MEVA encodes each modality on its own and then combines the two representations through a residual fusion step.
blocks.zh: 我们与Mesh-Enhanced Volumetric Autoencoder(MEVA)解决了这一缺口,这是一种双流结构,它同时使用量子磁共振和皮质地表表示. 卷流编码了T1加权磁共振卷,而网流则单独编码了由FreeSurfer重构表面产生的顶点-睿智地皮特征 22. MEVA自行将每种模式编码,再通过剩余聚变步骤将两种表示法合并.

blocks.en: We first trained and evaluated the two streams separately. GWAS of each stream showed that the mesh representation identified about a quarter as many significant loci as the volumetric representation (40 versus 153), yet the loci found by the two streams overlapped only in part. These findings suggest that the mesh representation carries weaker genetic signal overall but captures complementary genetic information that the volumetric stream only partly represents.
blocks.zh: 我们首先对两条溪流分别进行了培训和评估。 每一流的GWAS显示,网格表示与体积表示(40比153)相比,大约比四分之一的重要地块多,但两个地块发现的部分重叠。 这些研究结果表明,网状物代表体整体上带有较弱的遗传信号,但能捕捉到仅能部分代表体积流的互补遗传信息.

blocks.en: This observation motivated residual fusion over direct feature fusion. With the volumetric representation carrying much stronger genetic signal, unconstrained fusion risks either letting the volumetric stream dominate the joint representation and suppress mesh-specific information, or perturbing the strong volumetric representation and degrading genetic discovery. We therefore treat the volumetric representation as the primary one and learn the contribution of the mesh stream as a residual correction on top of it. This design preserves the genetic information already captured by the volumetric stream while allowing complementary mesh-derived information to improve the representation where it is informative. In the limiting case where the mesh stream adds little, the fused representation falls back toward the volumetric representation and performance is largely retained.
blocks.zh: 这种观察激发了残留聚变在直接特征聚变之上. 由于体积的表达具有更强的遗传信号,不受约束的聚变有风险,要么让体积的流主导联合表达并抑制网状信息,要么干扰强烈的体积的表达并降低基因的发现. 因此,我们把体积代表作为首要代表,并学习网格流的贡献作为顶部的剩余修正。 这种设计保存了已经被体积流所捕捉的遗传信息,同时允许补充的网生信息在信息丰富的地方改善表达. 在网格流增加不多的有限情况下,被接合的表示回到了体积表示,性能基本上得到保留。

blocks.en: We evaluate MEVA in three stages. First, we assess how much phenotypic information the learned representations carry through prediction of age and sex as well as mesh-derived IDPs, comparing MEVA with volumetric-only and mesh-only baselines to quantify the benefit of integration. Second, we perform GWAS on each dimension of the learned representation in the UK Biobank 23 discovery cohort, using the same individuals and pipeline for all models so that differences in locus counts and identity reflect the representation alone. Third, we will carry out downstream genetic analyses (enrichment of gene sets and tissue expression, together with genetic correlation with clinical phenotypes) to establish the biological relevance of MEVA-specific discoveries, and we will examine the encoder to learn where and why the mesh stream contributes new signal.
blocks.zh: 我们分三个阶段评估MEVA。 首先,我们评估通过预测年龄和性别以及网生境内流离失所者,所学到的信息有多少间质信息,将MEVA与只容积和网生基线进行比较,以量化融合的好处。 第二,我们利用同样的个人和管道对所有模型进行测试,以了解联合王国Biobank第23号发现群中的知识代表性的每个方面,从而将蝗虫计数和身份差异仅反映代表性。 第三,我们将进行下游遗传分析(丰富基因组和组织表达,加上与临床苯基的遗传相关性),以确定MEVA特定发现的生物相关性,我们将研究编码器,以了解网格流在哪些地方和为什么会提供新的信号.

blocks.en: This paper makes three contributions: • We demonstrate that cortical mesh features learned with a self-supervised autoencoder carry predictive and genetic signal complementary to that of volumetric representations. • We show that MEVA, by combining both streams, increases the number of genome-wide significant loci beyond either single-modality baseline. • We will provide an explainability analysis to test whether the mesh and volumetric streams contribute to distinct genetic axes, which would explain why the combined representation discovers more loci.
blocks.zh: • 本文件作出三项贡献: 我们证明,通过自我监督的自编码器所学到的皮质网状特征具有预测和遗传信号,与体积表达信号相辅相成。 我们显示,MEVA通过将两种流合在一起,使整个基因组的重要地块的数量超过单一模式的基线。 我们将提供一种可解释性分析,以检验网状和体积流是否有助于不同的遗传轴,这将解释为什么合并的表达会发现更多的地方。

A mesh-only autoencoder encodes the mid-thickness vertex coordinates, cortical thickness and curvature of FreeSurfer-derived cortical surfaces. Mesh-only phenotypes predicted age with a Pearson r of 0.671 and sex with an AUC of 0.886 (Table 1 ).

The third analysis compares genetic associations across representations in a common UK Biobank discovery cohort, using the same participants, covariates and association pipeline for every representation (Methods, Genome-wide association analysis). blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced MEVA, a dual-stream autoencoder that augments a volumetric MRI representation with a residual contribution from cortical mesh features, and showed that this integration yields a representation that is both more phenotypically informative and more genetically discoverable than either modality alone. MEVA achieved the best performance on both phenotype prediction tasks, reaching a Pearson correlation of 0.776 for brain age (compared with 0.768 for the volume-only and 0.671 for the mesh-only representation) and an AUC of 0.984 for sex classification (compared with 0.976 and 0.886, respectively). Beyond improved prediction, MEVA identified 188 genome-wide significant loci, exceeding both the volume-only (153 loci) and mesh-only (40 loci) baselines, and 42 of these loci were detected by neither unimodal representation. MEVA also attained the highest summed SNP heritability ( ∑ h SNP 2 = 36.7 \sum h^{2}_{\mathrm{SNP}}=36.7 , compared with 33.7 and 10.5) 24 , indicating that the additional loci reflect a genuine gain in captured heritable variation rather than a redistribution of existing signal across latent dimensions. Notably, although the mesh-only representation carried the weakest genetic signal on its own, adding it as a residual to the volumetric stream substantially increased the cortical thickness variance explained ( Δ ​ R 2 = 0.375 \Delta R^{2}=0.375 versus 0.091 0.091 for the volume-only model), showing that the fused phenotypes retain cortical information supplied by the mesh stream. Together, these results support residual fusion as an effective strategy for combining a strong primary modality with a weaker but complementary one, preserving the genetic signal of the volumetric representation while extending it with mesh-derived information.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们引入了MEVA这个双流自编码器,它用皮质网状特征的剩余贡献来增强体积核磁共振的能见度,并表明这种能见度不仅比两种模式都更能了解情况,而且更能发现基因。 MEVA在双酚类预测任务上都取得了最佳表现,大脑年龄的皮尔逊关联度达到0.776(而只容积为0.768,只容网代表为0.671),性别分类为0.984(分别为0.976和0.886). 除了改进预测外,MEVA还查明了188个全基因组范围的重要 Loci,超过了只容积(153 loci)和网状(40 loci)基线,其中42个 Loci没有通过单式表示检测出。 MEVA还实现了最高的SNP可遗传性(  h SNP 2 = 36.7\ sum h^{2}_{\ mathrm{ SNP}}= 36.7),而相较于33.7和10.5) 24,表明附加的地盘反映了在捕捉到的可遗传性变化中的真正收益,而不是现有信号在潜在维度上的再分配. 值得注意的是,虽然只网状的表示本身携带最弱的遗传信号,但加上它作为体积流的残余物,大大增加了所解释的皮质厚度差异(XQ R 2=0.375 = Delta R^{2}=0.375,而只网状模型为0.0910.091),表明被引信的苯基保留了由体积流提供的皮质信息. 这些成果共同支持将残余聚变作为一种有效战略,将强有力的主要模式与较弱但相辅相成的模式结合起来,保留体积表达的遗传信号,同时将其扩展为网状信息。

blocks.en: Residual fusion is only one of several strategies for integrating volumetric and surface representations, and alternative designs may capture complementary signal in different ways. A first alternative is contrastive alignment, in which modality-specific encoders are trained to map paired views of the same individual to nearby points in a shared embedding space 25 . We previously showed that contrastive learning across brain imaging modalities yields heritable multimodal representations 26 , and extending this objective to volume–mesh pairs could encourage the model to emphasize anatomical variation that is consistently expressed in both modalities. However, because contrastive objectives reward shared information, they may attenuate precisely the mesh-specific signal that residual fusion is designed to preserve. A second alternative is allocation-based fusion, in which the latent budget is explicitly partitioned into shared and modality-specific dimensions, or the contribution of each modality is adaptively weighted per dimension. Such a design would make the division of labor between the volumetric and mesh streams explicit, and would allow loci to be attributed to shared or modality-specific axes directly rather than through post hoc interpretation. A third alternative is fine-grained cross-attention between local tokens of the two modalities 27 ; 28 , for example between 3D patches of the MRI volume and vertices or vertex patches of the cortical mesh. Because each cortical vertex has a well-defined spatial location in the MRI volume, cross-attention at the patch and vertex level could learn anatomically grounded correspondences and allow surface geometry to modulate the volumetric features of the underlying tissue, at the cost of substantially higher computational and memory demands. Systematically comparing these fusion strategies under the same GWAS pipeline and evaluation framework 24 will be an important direction for determining which inductive biases best expose heritable brain variation.
blocks.zh: 残余聚变只是将体积和地表表达法结合起来的几种策略之一,替代设计可能以不同的方式捕捉到互补信号. 第一个选择是对比性对接,其中对模式特定编码器进行培训,将同一个人的对接视图映射到共享嵌入空间25中的相邻点. 我们以前曾表明,不同大脑成像模式的对比性学习产生了可遗传的多模式表述26,将这一目标扩大到量-mesh对可以鼓励模型强调在两种模式中一致表达的解剖变异。 然而,由于对比性目标能奖励共享的信息,它们可能恰恰会削弱残留聚变被设计为保存的网状特定信号. 第二种办法是基于分配的组合,其中将潜在预算明确分为共同的和特定模式的层面,或者每种模式的贡献按每个层面进行适应性加权。 这种设计将使量子流和网状流之间的分工变得明确,并使loci直接被归属于共享或模式特定轴,而不是通过事后解释。 第三个替代品是在两种模式的本地符相间有细纹相交; 28,例如MRI体积的3D补丁和皮质网状的顶点或顶点补丁相交. 由于每个皮质顶点在核磁共振卷中都有明确定义的空间位置,在补丁和顶点层的交叉注意可以学习解剖基础的函证,并允许地表几何来调节下层组织的体积特征,代价是计算和内存需求要高得多. 在同一GWAS管道和评价框架24下系统地比较这些聚变战略,将是确定哪些诱导性偏差最能暴露出遗传性脑变的重要方向。

blocks.en: The present analyses indicate that MEVA improves both phenotypic prediction and locus discovery, but they do not yet characterize the biology underlying the MEVA-specific loci. We are therefore extending this work in two directions. First, we are performing downstream genetic analyses of the MEVA GWAS, including gene-based and gene-set enrichment with MAGMA 29 , tissue-expression enrichment using GTEx 30 , and genetic correlation with neurological, psychiatric, and cardiometabolic phenotypes 31 , to determine whether the loci gained through fusion map to neurobiologically coherent pathways. Second, we are developing an explainability analysis that tests whether the fusion model’s attributions recover genetically informed cortical topography at the 42 fusion-specific lead variants. This analysis compares decoder-perturbation and input-gradient maps derived from the MEVA encoder with gene-expression-weighted cortical profiles constructed from the Allen Human Brain Atlas 32 , weighted by MAGMA gene associations, GTEx brain eQTL effects, or brain transcriptome-wide association statistics 33 . Concordance between the two would indicate that the mesh stream contributes signal that is anatomically localized to the cortical regions where the implicated genes are expressed, providing a mechanistic account of why the integrated representation discovers loci that neither unimodal baseline detects.
blocks.zh: 目前的分析表明,MEVA既改进了线粒体的预测,也改进了蝗虫的发现,但是它们还没有描述MEVA特有的地壳的生物学特征。 因此,我们正从两个方面扩大这项工作。 首先,我们正在对MEVA GWAS进行下游遗传分析, 包括基因基和基因集浓缩与MAGMA 29, 组织表达浓缩与GTEx 30, 以及遗传与神经、精神和心电图的关联性,31, 以确定通过聚变图获得的Loci是否与神经生物一致路径。 第二,我们正在开发一个解释性分析,测试核聚变模型的归属是否恢复了42个核聚变特定铅变体的基因知情地皮地形。 本分析将来自MEVA编码器的解码器-扰动和输入分级图与由Allen Human Brain Atlas 32所构建的基因表达加权皮质剖面图进行对比,该剖面图由MAGMA基因协会加权,GTEx脑eQTL效应,或全脑记录仪关联统计. 33 (英语). 两者之间的和谐将表明,网状流为表达被牵连基因的皮层区域提供了解剖本地化的信号,从而提供了一种机械化的叙述,说明综合代表为什么发现没有单一模式基线探测到的地方。

blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 UK Biobank participants
blocks.zh: 4.1 联合王国生物银行参与者

blocks.en: The UK Biobank 34 is a nationwide population resource encompassing approximately 500,000 participants recruited across the United Kingdom, with baseline phenotypic and genetic data collected between 2006 and 2010 and brain imaging from 2014 onwards. The study operates under established ethical approval, with governance and oversight details available at https://www.ukbiobank.ac.uk/learn-more-about-uk-biobank/governance/ethics-advisory-committee . Models were developed in the quality-controlled subset of participants described below. Phenotypes were then extracted for 35,298 participants with T1-weighted MRI, cortical surfaces and imputed genotypes 35 who were not used for model training; these participants form the genetic analysis cohort for every representation. The genetic analysis cohort had a mean age at imaging of 67.8 years (s.d. 7.7; range 46–87).

blocks.en: 4.2 MRI acquisition and volumetric preprocessing
blocks.zh: 4.2 核磁共振的获取和体积预处理

blocks.en: UK Biobank MRIs were downloaded on October 15, 2021. UK Biobank participants had birth years between 1934 and 1971. UK Biobank has provided a bias-field-corrected version of the brain-extracted T1-weighted (T1) acquired on Siemens Skyra 3T scanners (software VD13A SP4 as of October 2015) with a standard Siemens 32-channel RF receive head coil, at 1-mm isotropic resolution ( https://biobank.ctsu.ox.ac.uk/crystal/crystal/docs/brain_mri.pdf ).
blocks.zh: UK Biobank MRIs于2021年10月15日被下载. 英国 Biobank 参与者在1934年至1971年间出生年限. UK Biobank提供了从Siemens Skyra 3T扫描仪(截至2015年10月的软件VD13A SP4)上取取的有偏-场校正的T1加权(T1)版本,其标准Siemens 32-通道RF接收头圈,分辨率为1毫米同分线(https://biobank.ctsu.ox.ac.uk/crystal/crystal/docs/brane_mri.pdf).

blocks.en: To promote generalizability and minimize manual feature engineering, we adopted the standard preprocessing pipeline developed by the UK Biobank MRI team. Brain MRI preprocessing was performed primarily using FSL ( https://www.fmrib.ox.ac.uk/ukbiobank/ ), and included defacing, brain extraction with BET, linear and non-linear registration to standard MNI152 space using FLIRT and FNIRT, and bias-field correction using FAST. Bias-field-corrected, brain-extracted T1-weighted images were retained for analysis. All images were subsequently linearly registered to MNI152 space using affine transformation with 12 degrees of freedom via UK Biobank-provided precomputed matrices in FLIRT. Linear registration was chosen to normalize head size and achieve cross-subject alignment while preserving subject-specific structural deformations, in contrast to non-linear registration. The resulting linearly registered, defaced, bias-field-corrected images were used in all downstream analyses. Image intensities were normalized on a per-scan basis using Z-score normalization. Following affine registration, T1 weighted volumes had dimensions of 182 × \times 218 × \times 182 voxels and were zero-padded to 182 × \times 224 × \times 182.
blocks.zh: 为了促进通俗性,并尽量减少人工特性工程,我们采用了由英国Biobank核磁共振小组开发的标准预处理管. 脑磁共振预处理主要使用FSL(https://www.fmrib.ox.ac.uk/ukbiobank/)进行,包括诽谤、利用BET进行脑提取、利用FLIRT和FNIRT进行线性和非线性登记到标准的MNI152空间,以及利用FAST进行偏差-场校正。 保留了Bias-field校正后脑提取出T1加权图像进行分析。 之后,所有图像都通过FLIRT中的联合王国Biobank提供的预计算矩阵,使用有12度自由的等离子变换,线性地登记到MNI152空间。 选择线性注册是为了使头部大小正常化并实现跨主体对齐,同时保留特定主体的结构变形,与非线性注册形成对比. 所有下游分析都采用了由此产生的线性记录、被涂抹、偏差场修正图像。 利用Z分数的常态,使图像强度在每扫描一次的基础上正常化。 芳香花注册后,T1加权卷的尺寸为182×分218×分182分,并被零加到182×分224×分182分.

blocks.en: To construct a high-quality deep learning dataset, we leveraged UK Biobank’s precomputed MRI quality metrics: the inverted contrast-to-noise ratio (Data Field 25735) and the discrepancy between T2 FLAIR and T1 brain images (Data Field 25736). Images with values below the 95th percentile for both metrics (corresponding to higher-quality scans) were retained. For participants with multiple visits, only the first scan was kept to ensure consistency across the dataset. This filtering resulted in a cohort of 6,130 scans from individuals of diverse ethnic backgrounds. The pretrained volumetric autoencoder was trained on a random split of these scans into 4,597 training (75%) and 1,533 validation (25%) images, with the validation set reserved for hyperparameter tuning and checkpointing. The mesh autoencoder and MEVA were trained on the 6,067 of these participants with usable cortical surfaces.
blocks.zh: 为了构建一个高质量的深层学习数据集,我们利用了英国Biobank预先计算出的核磁共振质量衡量标准:倒数对比-噪声比(Data Field 25735)和T2 FLAIR和T1脑图像(Data Field 25736)之间的差异。 两个度量衡(相当于更高质量的扫描)的数值都低于95%的图像被保留. 对于多次访问的参与者,只保留了第一次扫描,以确保数据集的一致性。 过滤后,从不同族裔背景的个人中进行了6 130次扫描。 预先训练的体积自编码器接受了这些扫描随机分解的培训,分为4,597个培训(75%)和1,533个验证(25%)图像,其中的验证装置用于超参数调制和检查。 网络自编码器和MEVA在这些参与者中接受了6,067个具有可使用皮层表面的培训。

blocks.en: 4.3 Cortical surface preparation
blocks.zh: 4.3 表面皮制备

blocks.en: Cortical surfaces were reconstructed with FreeSurfer and resampled to the fsaverage4 icosahedral mesh, giving 2,562 vertices per hemisphere. Each vertex carries five channels: the x x , y y and z z coordinates of the mid-thickness surface, cortical thickness and curvature. The coordinates of each hemisphere were centred and scaled with a single centre and scale estimated on the training set, and thickness and curvature were standardized with training-set means and standard deviations.
blocks.zh: 皮层表面被与FreeSurfer一起重建并被再被复制到fs平均4相相干地膜上,每个半球得到2,562个顶点. 每个顶点有五个通道:中层地表的xx,y和z z坐标,皮质厚度和曲面. 每个半球的坐标都以中心为中心,并用单一的中央和规模来估计培训情况,厚度和曲率也以培训手段和标准偏差标准化。

blocks.en: 4.4 Mesh autoencoder
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 网格自动编码器

blocks.en: The mesh-only encoder is a masked graph autoencoder with 33,733 parameters, applied with shared weights to the fsaverage4 mesh graph of each hemisphere. The three coordinate channels and the two morphometric channels are embedded separately by two-layer perceptrons into 32 channels and summed. A graph U-Net backbone with graph convolutions, two levels of top- k k pooling (ratio 0.8) and unpooling with skip connections returns 32-channel vertex features, from which a vertex-wise perceptron reconstructs the five input channels. During training, 60% of the vertices are masked by setting their inputs to zero, 70% of them as contiguous two-hop patches around 16 seed vertices and the rest at random, and the loss is the mean squared reconstruction error over all vertices. The embedding z mesh z_{\mathrm{mesh}} is obtained by averaging the vertex features within each hemisphere, concatenating the two hemisphere means and mapping them through a two-layer perceptron to 128 dimensions. The model was trained on 4,853 participants, with 607 for validation and 607 held out, with a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and a batch size of one for 100 epochs; the checkpoint with the lowest validation reconstruction error (epoch 98) was retained. No genetic information was used.

blocks.en: 4.5 MEVA fusion and training
blocks.zh: 4.5 MEVA聚变和培训

blocks.en: MEVA combines the pretrained volumetric autoencoder with the frozen mesh encoder (Fig. 2 ). A fusion module f f computes a residual δ = f ⁡ ( z vol , z mesh ) \delta=f(z_{\mathrm{vol}},z_{\mathrm{mesh}}) , and the fused phenotypes are z fused = z vol + δ . z_{\mathrm{fused}}=z_{\mathrm{vol}}+\delta. (1) The last layer of f f is initialized to zero, so training begins from the volumetric representation, and z fused z_{\mathrm{fused}} is passed to the convolutional decoder to reconstruct the T1 image. Training used 5,461 participants, with 606 for validation and a batch size of two, in two stages. In stage 1 (4 epochs), f f is a residual multilayer perceptron applied to [ z vol , z mesh ] [z_{\mathrm{vol}},z_{\mathrm{mesh}}] (layer normalization, linear 256 → 128 256\to 128 , GELU, linear 128 → 128 128\to 128 ), and the loss combines masked T1 reconstruction with an instance-discrimination InfoNCE loss (weight 0.1, temperature 0.1, queue of 512) whose positive pairs are fused embeddings of two augmented views of the same T1 image. The convolutional encoder was fine-tuned with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} and the fusion module with 10 − 3 10^{-3} . In stage 2 (6 epochs), the encoder and a learned mesh adapter are retained and f f is replaced by a two-token transformer: z vol z_{\mathrm{vol}} and the adapted z mesh z_{\mathrm{mesh}} are processed as two tokens by two layers of four-head self-attention, concatenated and projected to δ \delta . The InfoNCE term is removed, and a distillation head D D (linear 128 → 128 128\to 128 , GELU, linear 128 → 128 128\to 128 ) predicts z mesh z_{\mathrm{mesh}} from z fused z_{\mathrm{fused}} with the target under stop-gradient, ℒ = ℒ T1 + λ ​ ℒ mesh , λ = 10 . \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{T1}}+\lambda\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mesh}},\qquad\lambda=10. (2) The final epoch of each stage was used. Surface information therefore enters MEVA only through z mesh z_{\mathrm{mesh}} and the distillation loss; vertex features are not reconstructed. The modules added to the volumetric autoencoder (adapter, fusion block and distillation head) have about 0.18 million parameters (Supplementary Table S2 ).

blocks.en: 4.6 Volumetric autoencoder baselines and training
blocks.zh: 4.6 卷体自编码器基线和培训

blocks.en: The volumetric stream uses the CNN autoencoder of our previous work 1 . The volume-only representation in this study is the pretrained CNN autoencoder (138.1 million parameters, trained for 40 epochs), used without further training; it also initializes the MEVA volume encoder.
blocks.zh: 使用CNN的自动编码器, 本研究中仅限量的表示是预先训练的CNN自编码器(1.381亿个参数,为40个纪元所训练),未经再训练而使用;还初始化了MEVA自编码器.

blocks.en: Briefly, the CNN architecture is an autoencoder with CNN blocks of 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 kernels and 2 × 2 × 2 2\times 2\times 2 max pooling. The model consists of 5 encoding CNN blocks, a fully connected layer with dimension 128 and 5 decoding CNN blocks.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,有线电视新闻网架构是一款自动编码机,有线电视新闻网块为3×3×3等分3等分3等分3等分3等分3等分3等内核和2×2等分2等分2等分2等分2等分最大集. 该模型由5个编码有线电视新闻网块组成,一个全相通的层,有尺寸128和5个解码有线电视网块.

blocks.en: 4.7 Embedding extraction
blocks.zh: 4.7 (中文(简体) ). 嵌入提取

blocks.en: For each representation, the encoder was frozen and the decoder and any auxiliary heads were removed. The MEVA encoder takes both the T1 image and z mesh z_{\mathrm{mesh}} computed from the participant’s cortical surface. The volume-only, mesh-only and MEVA encoders were applied to the same 35,298 genetic-analysis participants, giving a 35,298 × 128 35{,}298\times 128 phenotype matrix per representation.
blocks.zh: 对于每个代表,编码器被冻结,解码器和任何辅助头被取出. MEVA编码器既取自T1图像又取自z mesh z_{\mathrm{mesh}}从参与者皮层表面计算出. 仅有量,只网和MEVA编码器被应用于相同的35,298个基因分析参与者,给出了35,298×128 35{,}298\ times 128 phenotype矩阵每个表示.

blocks.en: 4.8 Phenotypic prediction and statistical analysis
blocks.zh: 4.8 预测和统计分析

blocks.en: Phenotypes were evaluated in the 35,298 held-out participants. Age was predicted by ridge regression ( α = 1 \alpha=1 ) with five-fold cross-validation and summarized by the Pearson correlation and mean absolute error between predicted and observed age. Sex was predicted by class-balanced logistic regression with stratified five-fold cross-validation and summarized by the AUC. Cortical information was measured as the incremental variance explained, Δ ​ R 2 = R 2 ​ ( measure ∼ phenotypes + covariates ) − R 2 ​ ( measure ∼ covariates ) \Delta R^{2}=R^{2}(\text{measure}\sim\text{phenotypes}+\text{covariates})-R^{2}(\text{measure}\sim\text{covariates}) , from ordinary least squares fitted in sample and averaged over the components of each measure set: FreeSurfer regional thickness, surface area and grey-matter volume of the 68 Desikan–Killiany regions 36 . Confidence intervals were obtained from 500 bootstrap resamples of participants; for Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} , both models were refitted on every resample and the interval is the point estimate ± 1.96 \pm 1.96 bootstrap standard errors.

blocks.en: 4.9 Genotype quality control
blocks.zh: 4.9 (中文(简体) ). 基因类型质量控制

blocks.en: We applied the quality-control pipeline of our previous work 1 to the imputed autosomal genotypes. Duplicated variants were removed, and individuals whose genetically inferred sex did not match their self-reported sex were excluded.
blocks.zh: 我们用我们之前工作1的质量控制管道 来计算自体基因型 重复的变体被删除,基因推断的性别与其自报的性别不符的个人被排除在外.

blocks.en: 4.10 Genome-wide association analysis
blocks.zh: 4.10 全基因组联系分析

blocks.en: For each representation, the 128 phenotypes were tested on their original scale, without rank-based inverse normal transformation, for association with 8,931,083 variants in the 35,298 participants, using fastGWA 37 with covariates, including age, age 2 , sex, their interactions, genetic principal components. The per-phenotype summary statistics were combined together with minimal p value, and genome-wide significance was set at P < 5 × 10 − 8 / 128 P<5\times 10^{-8}/128 . Total SNP heritability across multiple phenotypes was estimated with a sum-h2 pipeline 24 . blocks.en: 4.11 Genomic locus annotation
blocks.zh: 4.11 基因组蝗虫注释

blocks.en: Genomic loci were annotated using FUMA 38 . Lead SNPs were first identified based on linkage disequilibrium ( r 2 ≤ 0.1 r^{2}\leq 0.1 ) and physical proximity ( < < 250 kb), and assigned to non-overlapping genomic loci. Within each locus, the SNP with the lowest p-value (the top lead SNP) was used to represent the locus.
blocks.zh: Genomic loci是用FUMA 38注解的. 铅SNP首先根据联系不平衡(r 2 ≤ 0.1 r^{2}\leq 0.1)和物理相近( < 250克b)确定,并分配给非重叠基因组loci。 在每个蝗体内,用P值最低的SNP(上铅SNP)来代表蝗虫.

blocks.en: 4.12 Locus overlap analysis
blocks.zh: 4.12 国家 螺旋重叠分析

blocks.en: To assess locus overlap, each identified locus was extended by 125 kb on either side, and interval trees were constructed for each chromosome. Loci from our analysis were then queried against these interval trees to determine overlapping regions.
blocks.zh: 为了评估地壳重叠,在两边的每个已查明地壳被延长了125克,并为每个染色体建造了间隔树. 然后,我们对这些间隔树进行了调查,以确定重叠区域。
